notes.title: Summer Sale 2023: Take advantage of this unmissable discount on Explorers!
notes.notes:
[b]KINGDOM OF EXPLORERS[/b] is part of the highly anticipated "Summer Sale 2023" on Steam. That's right! We have prepared an exclusive offer, and if you already have the game on your wishlist, what are you waiting for to embark on this adventure right now?

Starting today, you can get our game with a special 30% discount throughout the Summer Sale, which runs from June 29th to July 13th, 2023. It's the perfect opportunity to embark on an epic journey and uncover the mysteries of the Hidden Island of Dwarves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43591661/e98c34f6e4c97f3e6ffdb4f86f4a898660b43c24.png[/img]
In [b]KINGDOM OF EXPLORERS[/b], you will be immersed in a universe full of adventure, challenges, and discoveries. Explore unknown lands, fight fearsome creatures[i] (like the Dark Knight, haha)[/i], and collect materials to upgrade your equipment.

Take advantage of this opportunity and don't forget to share this news with your friends who also want to experience this adventure. We hope you enjoy KINGDOM OF EXPLORERS to the fullest during the Early Access period!

notes.title: Now you can use Bow to attack...
A new Update is coming!
notes.notes:
Next Saturday, April 15th, there will be a big update for [i]Kingdom of Explorers[/i]. The upcoming news will be of great importance to the gameplay and we look forward to presenting it to you!

In response to numerous requests, now the bow can also be used in combat, YEAHHHHH! Just hold left SHIFT on keyboard (LB on controller) and press the attack button (left mouse or X/RT on controller).

And with the arrival of this novelty, there will now be a “Bow Shop” to improve your equipment. This bow upgrade will increase the damage done by the arrow and also the maximum capacity of arrows that will fit in the quiver.

And for you who are wondering: “how will I get new arrows?”. There are two ways to acquire them:

[list]
[*] When defeating enemies, some of them will “drop” arrows for you to pick up;
[*] There will be arrow crafting benches located at specific points on the map.
[/list]

Remembering that this is just one of the news that is coming in this new update. Stay tuned and we'll be back soon with more information.

notes.title: Update 0.1.0.15
notes.notes:
[h2]Death System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43591661/5b6bacfdcd840a049f6ce1521e406befe252a025.png[/img]

Now when you die, you lose all your resources, but you can recover them again!

CAUTION!!!
If you die again before recovering your old resources, you will LOSE THEM permanently!


[h2]Shield[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43591661/73a1c16737773141b29e5f7748f9795b9a1b2ed5.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Improved the countdown UI when the shield is broken.
[*] Fixed an issue where the countdown would continue after players respawned, even after the shield was broken and players died.
[/list]


[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the positioning of UI elements in the blacksmith's houses.
[*] Fixed the incorrect input image in the UI for reviving fallen players.
[/list]

[h2]Inputs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added the "SPACE" key for collecting resources
[/list]

[h2]Refineries[/h2]
[list]
[*] Now, when holding down the button for sending resources to refineries, it accelerates the process by 2X and 5X.
[/list]

[h2]Others[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved player attack accuracy
[*] Improved attributes of enemies in the East and West deserts.
[*] Players can now find resource piles while exploring.
[/list]
